resources.string: Send a definition or extension directly. No account or public catalogue.
Both devices must be on the same local network. This mode does not use Internet relays.
Encrypted peer transfer, with public n0 relays if needed. Relays see connection metadata; availability depends on their service.
Paste a link or transfer code
Only the selected file is shared, up to 128 MB. Received files require a separate review. Exported definitions exclude the secret vault; check any credentials you typed directly into the graph.
No sources yet. You can choose a file instead.
Keep this session open until the other device has received the file. You can use other screens.
Transfer stopped. The previous code is no longer usable.
The file matches its transfer hash. This does not establish trust in its author. Tap a file to review it before importing.
Importing saves a draft. It does not activate the source or authorize its scripts.
This signed extension needs Android installation. Review the system prompt before proceeding.
The transfer engine is unavailable for this build or device. You can still import a source file manually.
There is not enough free space to prepare and verify safely. Free more space for temporary copies, then try again.
This transfer code is invalid. Ask the sender for a new code.
This file is unavailable, invalid, or unsupported by this version. Choose a supported source file.
This extension uses split APKs and cannot be exported as a single file.
The transfer could not finish. Check the connection, network mode and sender session, then try again.
